brief: Verify a financial provider’s identity and permitted activity using the relevant official register.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Verify Providers"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Verifica con quién tratas"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Confira com quem você negocia"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Verify a financial provider’s identity and permitted activity using the relevant official register.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A familiar logo can be copied; verify the legal provider and its permitted activity through an independently reached official register.
instruction.misconception: A copied logo, brand name or registration screenshot verifies both provider identity and authorization for every activity.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Reach the official register independently. Match the legal name, identifier, contact details and permitted activity to the actual offer.
A separately reached official register does not rely on the sender.
Different legal identities prevent confirming this offer’s provider.
Registration for one activity does not establish permission for another.
The verified contact helps detect impersonation of a real firm.
Brand similarity does not settle identity or permitted activity.
A real firm’s name can be used by an impersonator.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
